MATCH (c:Country)-[:hasDiplomaticRelationWith]->(:Country {name: "Bolivia"}), (c)-[:hasDiplomaticRelationWith]->(:Country {name: "Paraguay"}) RETURN c.name ORDER BY c.founding_date DESC LIMIT 1
MATCH (p:PoliticalParty)-[:foundedBy]->(:Politician {name: "Maya Manolova"}), (p)-[:foundedBy]->(:Politician {name: "Tatyana Doncheva"}) RETURN p.name, p.founding_date
MATCH (c:Country)-[:hasDiplomaticRelationWith]->(i:Country)-[:hasDiplomaticRelationWith]->(b:Country {name: "Brazil"}) RETURN c.name, COUNT(DISTINCT i) as count ORDER BY c.name

MATCH (republicans:PoliticalParty {name: "The Republicans"})-[:headedBy]->(politician:Politician), (party:PoliticalParty)-[:headedBy]->(politician) WHERE party.name <> "The Republicans" RETURN DISTINCT party.name, party.founding_date

MATCH (c:Country)-[:hasHeadOfGovernment]->(p:Politician {name: "Donald Tusk"}), (party:PoliticalParty {name: "United People's Party"})-[:operatesIn]->(c)
RETURN c.name, c.official_language

MATCH (member:Country)-[:memberOf]->(org:InternationalOrganization {name: "Inter-American Tropical Tuna Commission"}), (country:Country)-[:hasDiplomaticRelationWith]->(member) RETURN country.name, COUNT(DISTINCT member) as member_count
MATCH (pp:PoliticalParty)-[:operatesIn]->(c:Country {name: "Greece"}) RETURN pp.name ORDER BY pp.founding_date DESC LIMIT 1
MATCH (pp:PoliticalParty)-[:operatesIn]->(c:Country)-[:hasHeadOfState]->(p:Politician {name: "Sandro Pertini"}) RETURN DISTINCT pp.name
